name: Vaelastrasz the Corrupt
source: [logs: Anniversary] Melee 3,325 to 4,705 before armor under the bench's raid debuffs, a swing every 2.64 s on the tank: Warcraft Logs, 27 kills on the Anniversary Hardcore realms (Normal, 2025-03-31 to 2025-07-31): the median of 120 normal hits' unmitigatedAmount (3,936), the 5th to 95th percentile of each hit over its own kill's median (116 hits) stretched to an even roll, and the swings a second while he was on the main tank. Taken back through the debuffs the bench puts on him (attack power 805 to 601, -37 a swing, attack speed 0.833): 2,706 weapon damage, spread 0.510, a 2.20 s swing. Length: his longest stretch on one tank a kill, median 17 s (10th to 90th percentile 11 to 27). Weapon damage abilities: Cleave 19983 3,028 to 5,914 from 29 hits. Abilities: Burning Adrenaline 23620 on the tank every 45 s (it dies 20 s later), so tanks swap every 45 s. Flame Breath 23461 3,500 to 4,500 Fire every 5 to 10 s, frontal, and 938 to 1,062 Fire every 3 s for 15 s, stacking to 5. Cleave 19983 every 5 to 10 s. Fire Nova 23462 555 to 645 Fire to the raid every 2 s. The Classic Era client's spell data, timers from the vmangos script.

notes: One tank's stint (Burning Adrenaline comes every 45 s), so the fight is his longest stretch on one tank in the logs. Flame Breath's DoT stacks to 5 (client data), which a sim DoT can't, so each stack is its own 1,000 Fire every 3 s, the stacks coming one a breath (every 7.5 s from 11 s) and staying up. Fire resistance takes its share of the Fire. The Burning Adrenaline on casters and the raid's Fire Nova on others are the healing sim's.

healing.notes: From the Anniversary Hardcore realms's logs (27 kills): while the boss was on the main tank, 6 healers had 5% or more of its healing (the median kill), and the healing it took from others was 4,284 a second with overheal and absorbs (27% of the heals effective), 3.37 heals and HoT ticks a second, against 1,213 damage taken a second. The tank's own heals (2% of its healing) are left out. Main tanks: Warrior 27.

raidHealing.notes: What the Anniversary Hardcore realms raids had on Vaelastrasz the Corrupt (27 kills, Warcraft Logs): the median kill's raid of 40 with 1 tanks (0 of them on adds, who took 0 a second together, not in the events), 11 healers by Warcraft Logs' healer role (85% of the healing), each 790 HPS with overheal. The raid healed 4,900 a second (1,187 on the tanks, 3,608 on the rest, 33% overheal on the rest). Each non-tank took 106.9 a second after mitigation. Fight length is the 10th percentile, median and 90th percentile kill. For the healing sim to check its healer counts against.

raidSource: [logs: the Anniversary Hardcore realms] The raidDamage events with who NotTanks: Warcraft Logs, 27 kills (tools/warcraftlogs/wclcli.py raid, tools/encounters/logs/anniversary_bwl_raid.json): the abilities that dealt 2% or more of the non-tanks' damage taken in 10% or more of the kills, 98% of it together, their rates scaled by 1.02 for the rest. Each is a share of the non-tanks, so the file fits any raid size. Fire Nova 23462 from Vaelastrasz the Corrupt (98% of the non-tanks' damage, in 27 of 27 kills): 554 to 646 unmitigated, the 5th to 95th percentile stretched to an even roll; 100% of the non-tanks a cast (10th to 90th percentile 97 to 100), 104.8 landed a second on each (71% of it landing), so a cast every 3.55 s at random (the logs count 15.9 casts a minute), the first at 3 s (median) of a 31 s kill. 23462's Everyone event keeps its own numbers on the tanks only. Together they land 106.8 a second on each non-tank over a median kill, at the logs' mitigation, against 106.9 in the logs.
